headerDisplay:
When your Ring Alarm goes off, your Sonos speakers announce it out loud, over and over until the alarm is cleared, then go back to what they were playing.

This adds to Ring's own siren and monitoring; it doesn't replace them. [Setup details](https://github.com/guilhermechapiewski/homebridge-ring-alarm-911-sonos-annunciator#readme).
footerDisplay: Use the "Test Alarm Announcement" switch in Apple Home to check that your speakers can be heard. Ring rotates the refresh token; the plugin keeps the latest one itself, so you only paste a new one if it loses access.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name shown in the Homebridge logs.

refreshToken.title: Ring refresh token
refreshToken.description: Run `npx -p ring-client-api ring-auth-cli` on any computer with Node.js 20+ (see the README). Use a token made just for this plugin, not homebridge-ring's.

rooms.title: Sonos rooms
rooms.description: Rooms to announce in, named as in the Sonos app. Leave empty to use every room.

locations.title: Ring locations
locations.description: Ring locations whose alarm should be announced, named as in the Ring app. Leave empty if your account has only one location with an alarm; required if it has several.

speakerAddresses.title: Sonos speaker addresses
speakerAddresses.description: Only if the speakers aren't found automatically (e.g. Homebridge in Docker, or speakers on another VLAN): the IP address of one or more Sonos speakers, optionally with :port. One reachable speaker is enough; the other rooms are found through it. When set, the network isn't searched.

volume.title: Announcement volume
volume.description: Volume (1-100) while announcing. Each speaker goes back to its own volume afterwards.

repeatIntervalSeconds.title: Repeat every (seconds)
repeatIntervalSeconds.description: Time from the start of one announcement to the start of the next.

maxAnnounceMinutes.title: Stop after (minutes)
maxAnnounceMinutes.description: Announcements stop after this long even if the alarm is still active in Ring.

audioPort.title: Clip server port
audioPort.description: The speakers fetch the announcement from this Homebridge machine. 0 picks a free port; set one if a firewall needs it fixed.
